Property.Name: QueryScript
Property.Value:
/* ============================================================= Purpose ------- Produce one current integrated LMTA client from stg.prism_clt_contact.
Authoritative contracts ----------------------- - LMTA Design Document v0.8 - LMTA physical Warehouse schema dated 2026-11-13 16:51 - Federal ALMP Schema 1.5
Important --------- source_load_id remains NULL because the current physical stg.prism_clt_contact table does not contain a Warehouse ingestion/load identifier. This is reported as a validation error rather than populated with an invented value. ============================================================= */
WITH active_code_map AS ( SELECT cm.source_column, cm.source_code, cm.almp_element, cm.almp_label, cm.almp_code,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cm.source_system, cm.source_table, cm.source_column, cm.source_code, cm.almp_element ORDER BY cm.effective_from DESC, cm.almp_code ) AS mapping_rank
FROM [ref].[code_map] AS cm
WHERE cm.source_system = 'PRISM_CLT' AND cm.source_table = 'contact' AND cm.almp_program_type = 'BOTH' AND cm.almp_schema_version = '1.5' AND cm.effective_from <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND ( cm.effective_to IS NULL OR cm.effective_to >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) ) ),
gender_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'gendercode' AND almp_element = 'gender' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
marital_status_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'familystatuscode' AND almp_element = 'maritalStatus' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
language_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'ict_languageofservices' AND almp_element = 'languageSpoken' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
disability_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'ict_disability' AND almp_element = 'disability' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
indigenous_identity_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'ict_indigenousidentity' AND almp_element = 'indigenousIdentity' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
immigrant_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'ict_citizenshipimmigrationstatus' AND almp_element = 'immigrant' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
visible_minority_map AS ( SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'ict_visibleminority' AND almp_element = 'visibleMinority' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
province_map AS ( /* This mapping will resolve only after province mappings are added to ref.code_map. Until then, province will be NULL and validation_status will be ERROR. */ SELECT source_code, almp_code, almp_label FROM active_code_map WHERE source_column = 'address1_stateorprovince' AND almp_element = 'province' AND mapping_rank = 1 ),
mapped_client AS ( SELECT /* ----------------------------------------------------- Internal identifier ----------------------------------------------------- */ CAST(c.contactid AS varchar(100)) AS client_id,
/* ----------------------------------------------------- Federal client fields ----------------------------------------------------- */ NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.ict_clientid AS varchar(30)))), '' ) AS clientID,
NULLIF( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.ict_sin AS varchar(30)))), '-', '' ), ' ', '' ), '.', '' ), '' ) AS socialInsuranceNumber,
NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.lastname AS varchar(100)))), '' ) AS lastName,
NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.firstname AS varchar(100)))), '' ) AS firstName,
TRY_CONVERT(date, c.ict_dateofbirth) AS dateOfBirth,
NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.emailaddress1 AS varchar(254)))), '' ) AS emailAddress,
gm.almp_code AS gender, msm.almp_code AS maritalStatus,
CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, c.numberofchildren) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN TRY_CONVERT(int, c.numberofchildren) ELSE NULL END AS numberOfDependantChildren,
lm.almp_code AS languageSpoken, dm.almp_code AS disability, iim.almp_code AS indigenousIdentity, imm.almp_code AS immigrant,
CASE WHEN imm.almp_code = '1' AND TRY_CONVERT(int, c.ict_yearofpermanentresidency) BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN RIGHT ( '0000' + CAST ( TRY_CONVERT( int, c.ict_yearofpermanentresidency ) AS varchar(4) ), 4 ) ELSE NULL END AS immigrationYear,
vmm.almp_code AS visibleMinority,
/* ----------------------------------------------------- Federal address fields ----------------------------------------------------- */ NULLIF ( CONCAT_WS ( ', ', NULLIF( LTRIM( RTRIM( CAST(c.address1_line1 AS varchar(250)) ) ), '' ), NULLIF( LTRIM( RTRIM( CAST(c.address1_line2 AS varchar(250)) ) ), '' ) ), '' ) AS streetAddress,
NULLIF( LTRIM( RTRIM( CAST(c.address1_city AS varchar(100)) ) ), '' ) AS municipality,
pm.almp_code AS province,
UPPER ( REPLACE ( NULLIF ( LTRIM ( RTRIM ( CAST( c.address1_postalcode AS varchar(10) ) ) ), '' ), ' ', '' ) ) AS postalZIPCode,
COALESCE ( NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.mobilephone AS varchar(30)))), '' ), NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.telephone2 AS varchar(30)))), '' ), NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.telephone1 AS varchar(30)))), '' ) ) AS contactPhoneNumber,
CAST(NULL AS varchar(1000)) AS addressSysComment,
NULLIF( LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(c.ict_message AS varchar(1000)))), '' ) AS sysComment,
/* ----------------------------------------------------- Common integration lineage columns ----------------------------------------------------- */ CAST('PRISM_CLT' AS varchar(50)) AS source_system, CAST('contact' AS varchar(100)) AS source_table, CAST(c.contactid AS varchar(100)) AS source_record_id,
/* Not physically available in the staging table. Do not manufacture a load identifier from a timestamp. */ CAST(NULL AS bigint) AS source_load_id,
TRY_CONVERT(datetime2(6), c.MODIFIED_ON) AS source_modified_on,
CAST(0 AS bit) AS is_synthetic,
CAST( 'PRISM_CLT_CONTACT_DIRECT' AS varchar(100) ) AS derivation_rule,
/* ----------------------------------------------------- Retained source values for mapping diagnostics ----------------------------------------------------- */ c.gendercode AS source_gender_code, c.familystatuscode AS source_marital_status_code, c.ict_languageofservices AS source_language_code, c.ict_disability AS source_disability_code, c.ict_indigenousidentity AS source_indigenous_identity_code, c.ict_citizenshipimmigrationstatus AS source_immigrant_code, c.ict_visibleminority AS source_visible_minority_code, c.address1_stateorprovince AS source_province_value
FROM [stg].[prism_clt_contact] AS c
LEFT JOIN gender_map AS gm ON gm.source_code = CAST(c.gendercode AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN marital_status_map AS msm ON msm.source_code = CAST(c.familystatuscode AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN language_map AS lm ON lm.source_code = CAST(c.ict_languageofservices AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN disability_map AS dm ON dm.source_code = CAST(c.ict_disability AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN indigenous_identity_map AS iim ON iim.source_code = CAST(c.ict_indigenousidentity AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN immigrant_map AS imm ON imm.source_code = CAST( c.ict_citizenshipimmigrationstatus AS varchar(50) )
LEFT JOIN visible_minority_map AS vmm ON vmm.source_code = CAST(c.ict_visibleminority AS varchar(50))
LEFT JOIN province_map AS pm ON pm.source_code = CAST(c.address1_stateorprovince AS varchar(50))
WHERE c.ict_clientid IS NOT NULL AND c.statecode = 0 ),
evaluated_client AS ( SELECT mc.*,
CASE WHEN mc.gender IS NULL OR mc.maritalStatus IS NULL OR mc.languageSpoken IS NULL OR mc.disability IS NULL OR mc.indigenousIdentity IS NULL OR mc.immigrant IS NULL OR mc.visibleMinority IS NULL OR mc.province IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS bit) ELSE CAST(1 AS bit) END AS mapping_complete,
CONCAT_WS ( '; ',
CASE WHEN mc.source_load_id IS NULL THEN 'source_load_id is unavailable in stg.prism_clt_contact' END,
CASE WHEN mc.socialInsuranceNumber IS NULL THEN 'Missing socialInsuranceNumber' WHEN LEN(mc.socialInsuranceNumber) <> 9 THEN 'socialInsuranceNumber must contain 9 digits' WHEN mc.socialInsuranceNumber LIKE '%[^0-9]%' THEN 'socialInsuranceNumber contains non-numeric characters' END,
CASE WHEN mc.lastName IS NULL THEN 'Missing lastName' END,
CASE WHEN mc.dateOfBirth IS NULL THEN 'Missing or invalid dateOfBirth' WHEN mc.dateOfBirth > CAST(GETDATE() AS date) THEN 'dateOfBirth is in the future' END,
CASE WHEN mc.gender IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped gendercode' END,
CASE WHEN mc.maritalStatus IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped familystatuscode' END,
CASE WHEN mc.numberOfDependantChildren IS NULL THEN 'numberOfDependantChildren must be 0-99' END,
CASE WHEN mc.languageSpoken IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped ict_languageofservices' END,
CASE WHEN mc.disability IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped ict_disability' END,
CASE WHEN mc.indigenousIdentity IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped ict_indigenousidentity' END,
CASE WHEN mc.immigrant IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped ict_citizenshipimmigrationstatus' END,
CASE WHEN mc.immigrant = '1' AND mc.immigrationYear IS NULL THEN 'immigrant=1 requires immigrationYear' END,
CASE WHEN mc.visibleMinority IS NULL THEN 'Missing or unmapped ict_visibleminority' END,
CASE WHEN mc.streetAddress IS NULL THEN 'Missing streetAddress' END,
CASE WHEN mc.municipality IS NULL THEN 'Missing municipality' END,
CASE WHEN mc.province IS NULL THEN 'Missing province mapping for address1_stateorprovince' END ) AS calculated_validation_message
FROM mapped_client AS mc )
SELECT /* Approved int.client contract */ client_id, clientID, socialInsuranceNumber, lastName, firstName, dateOfBirth, emailAddress, gender, maritalStatus, numberOfDependantChildren, languageSpoken, disability, indigenousIdentity, immigrant, immigrationYear, visibleMinority, streetAddress, municipality, province, postalZIPCode, contactPhoneNumber, addressSysComment, sysComment,
source_system, source_table, source_record_id, source_load_id, source_modified_on, is_synthetic, derivation_rule, mapping_complete,
CAST ( CASE WHEN calculated_validation_message IS NULL OR calculated_validation_message = '' THEN 'VALID' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS varchar(20) ) AS validation_status,
CAST ( NULLIF(calculated_validation_message, '') AS varchar(2000) ) AS validation_message
FROM evaluated_client
